title: news home preview
description: Render the home page locally with a checked draft, by the site's own SSR in local mode (ADR 0010, section 6). Starts the preview server (`bun --bun astro dev` with NEWS_PREVIEW=1, in site/) when nothing listens on NEWS_PREVIEW_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:4321), sends the draft as curation.v1 to PUT /__preview/curation and checks that the page answers X-News-Preview equal to the SHA-256 of the bytes sent. The four views share one URL: the colour scheme and the width belong to the browser, so Board sets them when it takes the screenshots. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

sha256.description: Of the curation.v1 bytes the server holds.
